channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Russia sanctions, Iran War, energy and Ukraine: What Jaishankar and Rubio discussed on UNGA sidelines
item.description: The two leaders discussed ‘sanctions’ that could be levelled against countries that engage economically with Russia and Iran, the US state department said in a statement.

item.title: Oil Holds Advance on Renewed Tensions Between the US and Iran
item.description: Oil held a gain on renewed tensions between the US and Iran, with a defiant message from President Masoud Pezeshkian highlighting the still-wide gap between the two sides after months of war in the Middle East.

item.title: Hurricane Watch Posted on Hawaii’s Big Island as Nolo Approaches
item.description: A hurricane watch has been issued for Hawaii’s Big Island as Tropical Storm Nolo strengthens south of the island chain.

item.title: Zelensky at UNGA: ‘Limit Putin's money. Limit his war’ — key takeaways from Ukraine president’s address
item.description: Zelensky argued that limiting Moscow’s ability to generate revenue was central to constraining its military campaign. “Russia’s revenues must remain a target.”

item.title: White House denies report of 90-day US diesel export ban
item.description: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright said a blanket diesel export ban would not work and could instead push up prices of gasoline and jet fuel.

item.title: CDC Recognizes Measles Death After Pennsylvania Conflict
item.description: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention confirmed one measles-related death in the US, almost a month after Pennsylvania first reported deaths to the agency.

item.title: Indian woman spends over ₹1 cr living in Manhattan, pays ₹10 lakh monthly rent; internet calls NYC life ‘overhyped’
item.description: Indian woman's video has gone viral as she talked about paying ₹10 lakh rent a month for a 2bhk apartment in NYC. She said that she is sharing the apartment with her partner.

item.title: FIFA fans in Delhi, Gurugram can revisit Spain’s World Cup win on Coca-Cola’s Golden Can: Where to buy, price and more
item.description: Coca-Cola India has launched a limited-edition golden can in Delhi-NCR to celebrate Spain’s FIFA World Cup victory. The collectible is part of 'Own a Piece of History' campaign that connects football fans to memorable moments. Where can you buy it from?

item.title: Trump-Xi summit itinerary: Full schedule of Chinese president’s 3-day US state visit from Sept 23-25
item.description: Trump is set to give Xi a high-profile welcome, with the visit featuring an airport arrival ceremony, White House meetings, a state dinner and a visit to the National Archives.

item.title: ₹1.5 lakh ‘donation’ for 2-year-old’s preschool admission? Ahmedabad entrepreneur’s post sparks debate
item.description: Pritesh Lakhani shared his experience on X while looking for a preschool for his daughter, who recently turned two.

item.title: Jaishankar raises India’s concerns over US Russia sanctions law with Rubio at UNGA
item.description: The talks focused on the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 (SRIA), which was signed into law by Trump last week. The legislation gives US authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on countries that continue purchasing Russian oil and gas, including India and China

item.title: Who will be next UN chief? Meet 7 candidates in race to replace Guterres; how secretary-general is chosen | Explained
item.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres will step down on December 31, marking nearly a decade in office. Seven candidates are vying to succeed him, with a new UN leader set to begin on January 1, 2027, following informal polls and recommendations from the Security Council.

item.title: Cyclone tracking: Deep depression nears Andhra - Odisha coast; IMD issues red alert. Is there a holiday tomorrow?
item.description: Schools have been shut in at least eight districts of Odisha — Nabarangpur, Malkangiri, Puri, Jagatsinghpur, Ganjam, Gajapati, Koraput and Khurda.

item.title: ‘Why don’t you give New Jersey to Israelis?’ Syria’s al-Sharaa recalls Trump exchange over Golan Heights at UNGA
item.description: Al-Sharaa said he made the remark after Trump told him that the Golan Heights belonged to Israel. He added that the joke did not change his position that the territory belongs to its people.

item.title: Amazon, Zepto & 3 other platforms face FSSAI's penal action over misleading claims: Which products did it flag?
item.description: The FSSAI has initiated regulatory action against Amazon, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket, Flipkart India, and Zepto for food safety violations, including misleading claims and the sale of restricted products.

item.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison in #MeToo-era case after retrial
item.description: The sentence follows a 2025 retrial in which a Manhattan jury again found Weinstein guilty of a first-degree criminal sex act involving former production assistant Miriam Haley.

item.title: ' ₹12K for rent, ₹1.4L for daughter's education': Auto driver shocks people with no savings despite ₹75K monthly earning
item.description: An auto driver talked about his monthly expenses, such as EMI, rent and more, revealing that he usually ends up with no savings. His story has left people divided on the internet.

item.title: US homebuyers could get $50,000 down-payment aid: Who qualifies
item.description: The proposal comes as high mortgage rates and elevated home prices continue to make homeownership difficult for many prospective buyers.

item.title: How much do H1B visa holders need to live in US? Indian startup founder reveals cost of living, ‘Nobody tells you…’
item.description: Entrepreneur Aniruddha Anjana notes that high American salaries, when converted to Indian rupees, can be misleading because of family expenses. Using the 50/30/20 budgeting rule, he compares living costs across various US cities.

item.title: Iran President's UNGA speech: ‘We are victims of terrorism’, ‘Iran wants nuclear energy, not a bomb’ — 10 key takeaways
item.description: Pezeshkian’s UNGA message was built around three themes: Iran sees itself as the victim rather than the aggressor, it will resist military pressure, and it remains willing to pursue diplomacy — but not under what it considers coercive conditions.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war disrupts wheat supply: Which countries are running short and where are they turning for supplies?
item.description: Russia-Ukraine war is disrupting wheat shipments from the Black Sea, forcing major buyers such as Egypt, Indonesia and Vietnam to seek supplies from Australia, Argentina, France and other exporters, as tighter supplies push up prices and raise food inflation risks.

item.title: 100% job placement guarantee goes unfulfilled: MBA graduate drags institute to court, gets full refund
item.description: A Punjab consumer commission has ordered Eduinx Education Services to refund ₹84,960 to an MBA graduate for unfulfilled placement guarantees.&nbsp;

item.title: Trump and Xi may not resolve their AI rivalry, but AI safety could open door for dialogue
item.description: Artificial intelligence is becoming a crucial topic in the US-China tensions. As leaders meet, they may explore cooperation on AI while competing over technology control, impacting economy and national security.

item.title: Bittu Tabahi's river clean-up campaign reaches Delhi-NCR, removes 585 kg waste from Yamuna and 2,435 kg from Gurgaon
item.description: Sharing a video on Instagram, he said that he, along with other volunteers, cleaned the river for three days, and on the first day, removed roughly 585 kg of waste from the riverbank.

item.title: Iran President Pezeshkian to speak at UNGA today: What to expect from his address
item.description: Pezeshkian's UNGA appearance comes at the intersection of two developments: Tehran's effort to present its case before the international community and renewed indirect diplomacy with Washington.

item.title: Gaza recovery plan: How Trump's $2.45 billion plan proposes to build a new Palestinian administration
item.description: The proposal, developed over about a year by members of the 28-country Board of Peace and the Palestinian technocratic government, covers infrastructure, housing, security, healthcare, education, digital services and economic development.

item.title: Election Commission row: What sparked controversy over SIR? Oppn demands Gyanesh Kumar’s arrest; BJP reacts | Explained
item.description: A political controversy arose after a report indicated two Election Commissioners raised objections 14 times over 10 months over decisions affecting the electoral process. Opposition parties demanded action against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, accusing him of electoral manipulation.

item.title: Hyderabad man irked by struggles of Indian passport, claims zero advantage despite paying ₹1 cr tax: ‘Can’t go anywhere’
item.description: A businessman has called the Indian passport ‘useless’ on X and laid down pointers behind his thought. He also talked about how useful a US visa can be for holders.

item.title: El Niño could kill 15,800 in India within next 6 months, says survey: What is it? How does it affect temperatures?
item.description: The study warned that India could see a significant share of these deaths during the winter months, with the impact expected to continue into the country's summer.

item.title: Deep depression to bring heavy rain across central, eastern India
item.description: The system is expected to cross the north Andhra Pradesh–south Odisha coasts by 23 September, with heavy to very heavy rainfall forecast across several states through 29 September as the southwest monsoon retreats.

item.title: Ex-ADC Major Rishabh Singh Sambyal’s ADC role explained: How many aides does the President have?
item.description: Aide-de-Camp (ADC) is an honorary position in the Indian Armed Forces. ADCS are appointed from the three wings — the Indian Army, Indian Navy and Indian Air Force.

item.title: Applying for Canadian citizenship? 6 document mistakes that could delay your application
item.description: Before submitting your Canadian citizenship application, double-check your documents. Ensure you're using the latest checklist, arrange your forms correctly, and include necessary passport copies. Clear and readable copies are vital to avoid processing delays or rejection.

item.title: Vada pav seller used to sell outside a bungalow; he owns it now: Internet reacts, ‘Hard work really wins’
item.description: Anilbhai, a vada pav vendor in Surat since 1997, attributes his success to his mother's efforts and blessings. Despite owning a bungalow, he continues to work at his cart, inspired by a hard life and the traditional recipe that lends his vada pav a unique flavour.

item.title: Explainer: What’s behind PM Narendra Modi’s Chintan Shivir?
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will have a Cabinet-only Chintan Shivir on Wednesday and Thursday to review the government's performance, discuss priorities, and speed up reforms under the Viksit Bharat@2047 vision while focusing on economic growth.&nbsp;

item.title: Can Trump legally ban media outlets from White House? DOJ says yes — here's what happens next
item.description: In a court filing, the DOJ defended Trump's ban on three news outlets, asserting that White House access is a privilege tied to national security. The outlets are suing, arguing the ban infringes on their First Amendment rights and violates due-process principles.
